meta.title: Maldives — Key Statistics
meta.subtitle: A small, fragmented island state with strong human development, a tourism- and import-dependent economy, high debt exposure, and exceptional vulnerability to sea-level rise and coastal hazards.

sections.title: SOCIAL
sections.strap: Strong human development, but an extraordinary settlement geography: many islands, very high concentration in Malé, and small communities spread across the archipelago.

sections.title: ECONOMIC
sections.strap: Maldives earns heavily from global tourism while depending on imported goods, food and fuel. High public debt adds another layer of exposure to external shocks.

sections.title: ENVIRONMENTAL
sections.strap: The Maldives combines a tiny land base with a vast ocean territory, while homes, infrastructure and economic assets sit extremely close to the sea.
